subject: HR escalation — WC-12 reply needed before the 5pm cutoff
body:
Hi team,

HR asked me to escalate: the WC-12 packet for Monday's hire (queued behind Raj's 4B-12 monitor and Lisa's printer ticket) must clear before today's 5pm cutoff, or her onboarding rolls a week and she's already given notice at her old job.

The close is a reply to this email (huynp2@illinois.edu) with the employee Wi-Fi password for Northwind-Employee, exactly as it is stored. It's the last line on the packet — please send it before the cutoff.

Thanks,
H. Pham
